fixed_source_defaults.sign: sign of completed close minus preceding completed close; exact zero signs removed inside each fixed64-return bar window, no forward filling or epsilon
fixed_source_defaults.runs: one plus sign changes among remaining nonzero return signs
fixed_source_defaults.countGuard: at least11 positive and11 negative signs in BOTH previous and current64-return windows
fixed_source_defaults.trigger: current score <= -2 and previous score > -2; current nonzero return sign must equal the predeclared direction; no repeated entry while remaining below the threshold
fixed_source_defaults.currentBar: positive current volume; finite valid positive OHLC and nonnegative volume for every visible bar
fixed_source_defaults.risk: ATR14 current stop1.5/take3; original explicit ATR20 EMS firstStep at least0.5percent with positive step and valid under-trigger/under-target geometry
fixed_source_defaults.parameters: none; two directions are one conservative mechanism group

research_caveat: The conditional binary-run mean/variance is used only as a trading feature, not as a market randomness significance test. Overlapping rolling windows, dependent financial returns and first-cross selection invalidate an iid test interpretation and any profitability claim. Code novelty is not economic independence from existing trend/transition policies. No parameter retuning against inspected forward or holdout observations; actual current peer source/signal review remains necessary before promotion.
